title: MVP, SMC groups to invest P120-B for Balintawak-Bocaue elevated road network: Marcos
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. announced Thursday MVP Group’s P120-billion investment to construct an elevated road network from Balintawak in Quezon City to Bocaue, Bulacan.
